function.arguments: {"recipient_id": "C4", "purpose": "optional_advice", "message": "Hi Morgan, I’m planning a 2-hour maintenance window that must fall on a Saturday or Sunday before August 31. The staff assigned are on-call A and on-call B. To minimize customer disruption, what time slot would you recommend for this maintenance, and are there any operational considerations I should include in the mitigation plan?"}

function.name: submit_answer
function.arguments: {"answer": {"baseline_summary":{"duration_hours":2,"allowed_days":["Saturday","Sunday"],"staff":["on-call A","on-call B"],"deadline":"August 31"},"recommendation":"Schedule the maintenance on a Sunday, 02:00–04:00 local time, during the last allowed weekend before August 31. Sunday early morning is typically the lowest-traffic period, minimizing customer impact. Both on-call A and on-call B should be alerted 30 minutes prior to the window. The mitigation plan should include: (1) pre-maintenance customer notification at least 48 hours in advance; (2) a staged rollout with automated health checks; (3) a rollback procedure on standby; (4) real-time status page updates; and (5) post-maintenance validation before declaring the window closed.","quality_notes":["Sunday 02:00–04:00 selected because weekend early-morning hours generally see the lowest user activity.","Staffing is limited to on-call A and on-call B; no additional personnel are required for a 2-hour window.","The August 31 deadline constrains the window to the final weekend before that date.","Mitigation focuses on advance notice, rollback readiness, and validation to minimize disruption."]}}
